description: Issue #50, dispatch side: the plan names no file for #220, so the contract would carry an empty scope.allow. That used to be dispatched with `success.requireScopeClean: false` — the one configuration in which a worker may write ANY file in the worktree and still be judged clean, i.e. the issue whose files nobody could name got the widest permission of all. The runner now refuses: no contract is placed, no send happens, the wave does not advance, and contract_scope_unknown says why. The scenario would have let this worker complete and verify, so a green run here would be the bug. An issue nobody can name a file for also carries Issue #52's open question, and that gate fires first; `--allow-questions` waives it so this case still exercises the scope refusal underneath rather than stopping one layer early.
